systemStatus.detail:
MON AUG 17 ~7:10AM RUN (second pass after the 4AM run, which found both feeds missing).

TOAST -- Sunday Aug 16 Group email arrived 6:31 AM PT. Net $5,875.95 / gross $6,116.20. Against last Sunday (Aug 9: net $8,201.25) that is -28.4%; against the 4-week Sunday average of $8,469.36 it is -30.6%. The gap is traffic, not ticket: 147 orders (-35.2% SDLW) and 234 guests (-26.6%), while avg/order of $39.97 was +10.6% SDLW and only -0.5% vs the 4-week average. Labor is the number to watch -- 25.1% of net (~$1,474.86) vs 19.3% last Sunday and a 21.2% 4-week average; a 12-person / 58.50-hour Sunday roster ran against materially softer sales. Also: 17 void items (11 SDLW), 1 order left open at closeout, takeout down to 6 orders / $106.25 from 25 / $231.50. This is the GROUP email only -- discount and labor DOLLARS are derived from reported percentages, and there is no daypart / room / category detail. The single-location DPS for Aug 16 had not arrived by run time (it landed 7:39 AM PT yesterday), so expect it shortly. Saturday Aug 15 remains the newest COMPLETE report and is preserved in toastPrevDay / toastLastKnown.

SLING -- today's (Mon Aug 17) summary received 7:00 AM PT. 5 employees / 6 shifts / 23.50 hours / 0 uncovered / 0 OT / 0 off. Cook IS on the roster (Rafael Patricio), so no kitchen-coverage gap. Julianna Ornelas appears twice (Barista and Server), which is why 5 people cover 6 shifts. Worth noting the contrast: 23.50 hours today vs 58.50 yesterday -- less than half. Given Sunday's 25.1% labor reading, a lean Monday is directionally right, but it is a thin roster if volume shows up.

GOOGLE ADS -- live scrape of CID 343-687-4835 with the range set to Yesterday (Aug 16). $28.35 spend, 1,154 impressions, 28 clicks, 2.43% CTR, $1.01 avg CPC, 0 conversions. Spend fell -$116.46 (-80.4%) from Saturday's $144.81 WHILE impressions rose +194 -- avg CPC dropped -$3.66 (-78.3%). Performance Max is the whole story: $18.72 yesterday vs roughly $127 on Saturday, on 849 impressions / 18 clicks. BHC Coffee Search spent $9.63 on 305 impressions / 10 clicks (3.28% CTR, the best of the account). Oldest SB Brewery on Tap and World Cup HQ 2026 are both paused at $0. Two standing problems: zero conversions for a third straight day, and PMax showing 'Eligible (Limited)' with ALL asset groups limited by policy -- the policy limitation, not the budget, is the fixable item.

YELP ADS -- scrape failed again. biz.yelp.com/ads/FTFaEinJgzqY0ZHQMUSpQQ/dashboard redirects to biz.yelp.com/login with an email + password form. Credentials were NOT entered. This is the 10th consecutive day of the login wall (first seen Aug 8), so every Yelp figure on the dashboard is frozen at the Aug 7 live read and should not drive decisions. An alert email was sent to Joal this morning asking him to sign back into Yelp for Business in Chrome.

TRIPADVISOR -- no performance report from analytics@hm2.tripadvisor.com in the last 3 days. Nothing actionable.

UNCHANGED THIS RUN -- reviews, reservations, Yelp inquiries, business profile and payroll were all refreshed at the 4AM run and are carried forward as-is.

unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, three hours each way is about the highest compliment a kitchen can get -- thank you. Glad the crew took care of you; they earned that one. Come see us next trip down, first round's on the house. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, so glad you and your pup both found what you were after. The patio is one of our favorite things about this place and dogs are always welcome out there. Safe travels home to San Diego -- stop in again next time you're headed down the coast. -- The Brewhouse
